## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · devx seat 2 · 2026-10-26T14:08Z

Seat `domain:devx#2` (#20163) · `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9` · reviewed head `2f44043aea` · card #26079, claim 6417130710 (file surface widened by the seat to the CI-run self-test), ruling 6417011624 (letter A′).

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #26079`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Ruling-ref: 6417011624` at line start. One commit.
- **Ruled scope held:** only the generator's behaviour changes. No `package.json` `files` entry is touched, so `CHANGELOG.md` keeps shipping (AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails, as the ruling requires); no existing CHANGELOG text is rewritten (#25919 A).
- **Scope:** exactly the two claimed files (+253/−4), neither governed: `scripts/changeset-changelog.mjs` (+184/−3) and `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` (+69/−1). No `.changeset` entry, which is right for repo tooling ⇒ `skip-changeset`.
- **Readings of the diff:**
  - The fold is gated three ways, all read off the file as it stood before the cut: `.changeset/pre.json` `mode` must be `exit`; the CHANGELOG's top section must have been a prerelease (read from the head of the file only, so spec's 10 MB is not loaded to decide); and after the pass the file must open with a stable section sitting directly above that same prerelease version. A package whose top is already stable is never armed.
  - Only the prerelease sections between the new stable section and the next stable one below are considered. Everything else, older cycles included, is copied byte for byte.
  - A section folds only when every changeset entry it carries is found in the new stable section, compared without the commit prefix. A section holding an entry the stable section does not reproduce is kept whole with a `::warning::` naming it — the conservative direction.
  - `Updated dependencies` entries (and their indented `pkg@version` lines, which the parser keeps with their entry) are left out of the comparison, so a dependency bump never holds a section back. The stable section carries its own.
  - The generator API has no post-write hook, so the fold is armed on the first release line and applied from `process.once('exit')`, only on exit code 0.
- **Gates:** I re-ran the CI self-test (`node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`, lint.yml:3329) on this head in a clean worktree: 34 batteries, floor raised 31 → 34, and all three new `changelog fold` batteries pass, including the armed/not-armed case over a real git fixture. `@changesets/cli` is not installed in my container, so I stubbed `@changesets/cli/changelog` to let the dynamic import resolve; the one case that fails under that stub is the pre-existing attribution battery asserting the stock line format, which the stub cannot reproduce. The dev's own run with the real dependency reports 136 cases over 34 batteries green, 33/33 derived gate families exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED, plus a real CLI end-to-end (`pre enter` → next.0 → next.1 → `pre exit` → 1.2.0 folds 4 sections, against a control leg on main that keeps 5). CI on this head was still running at review; the flip to ready waits for every check green or skipped.
- **Accepted deviation:** the claim's file surface was widened before work began, because `changeset-changelog.mjs` has no self-test CI runs; the pins belong in the one that does, following #25669's precedent.
- **Confidence gap, recorded:** `hotcrm@9464673` has no script reading an installed package's CHANGELOG; `cloud` is NOT MEASURED. The ruling's question was the tarball copy, which this PR leaves in place, so nothing is blocked on it.
- **Out of scope:** none filed.
